/-- One term of `∑_d f(d)² S_d²`. -/
theorem fo_sq_Sd_sq_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) {d : ℕ} (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) :
    fo d ^ 2 * Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) ^ 2 ≤
      0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have hg1 := gmain_nonneg (1 / 9) d
  have hg2 := gsq_nonneg d
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd d with he | ho
  · have : fo d = 0 := by simp [fo, Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 he]
    rw [this]
    have : 0 ≤ 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by positivity
    simpa using this
  have hS := abs_Sd_le hx hd1
  set A := ⌊x⌋₊ / d
  have hP1 := PS9_le ho A
  have hP2 := PSh_le ho A
  set R1 := ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho (1 / 9) p
  set R2 := ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho (1 / 2) p
  set α := 0.03 * (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x * (2.9733 * R1) with hα
  set β := √2 * √(d : ℝ) / √x * (11.4874 * R2) with hβ
  have hab : |Sd d A| ≤ α + β :=
    hS.trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP1 (by positivity))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP2 (by positivity)))
  have hsq : Sd d A ^ 2 ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 := by
    calc Sd d A ^ 2 = |Sd d A| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ (α + β) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hab 2
      _ ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α - β)]
  have hβ2 : β ^ 2 = 2 * d / x * (11.4874 * R2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hβ, mul_pow, div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
      Real.sq_sqrt hx0.le]
  calc fo d ^ 2 * Sd d A ^ 2 ≤ fo d ^ 2 * (2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = 2 * (0.03 * 2.9733) ^ 2 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d +
        2 * (2 * 11.4874 ^ 2) / x * gsq d := by
        rw [hβ2, hα, gmain, gsq_apply]
        field_simp
        ring
    _ ≤ 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by
        gcongr
        · norm_num
        · norm_num

proof_context.conclusion: Termwise split into a 0.03²-term with weights gmain(1/9,d) and a √2-term with gsq(d).

calc 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, gmain (1 / 9) d +
        527.85 / x * ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, gsq d
      ≤ 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * 1.48 + 527.85 / x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ 2 := by
        gcongr
    _ ≤ 0.0236 / Real.log x ^ 2 + 528 * (1 + Real.log x) ^ 2 / x := by
        have e1 : 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * 1.48 = 0.02355124 / Real.log x ^ 2 := by ring
        have e2 : 527.85 / x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ 2 = 527.85 * (1 + Real.log x) ^ 2 / x := by ring
        rw [e1, e2]
        gcongr
        · norm_num
        · norm_num

proof_context.conclusion: Summing over d ≤ N gives the two-term bound.

proof.summary: `fo_sq_Sd_sq_le` splits each term into two weighted parts, and `abs_g2_le_large` sums them over d to get the two-term bound.
